name: Local Corner Criterion
statement: For any Boolean class $C$ and vertex $v\in C$, let $I_C(v)$ be the coordinates of the neighbours of $v$ in $C$. Then $v$ is a corner exactly when the cube spanned by $v$ in all directions $I_C(v)$ is contained in $C$. If a corner belongs to a coordinate face, it remains a corner in the induced section on that face.
proof: Every cube through $v$ uses only incident directions. If their full span is present, it contains every cube through $v$ and is the unique maximal one. Conversely, when $v$ has a unique maximal cube, every incident edge extends into that cube, so its support contains every incident direction and it equals the full span.
